title: Waypoint Compass
html:
Waypoint Compass

Use this mystical compass to create a Waypoint that will always* take you back to the Dungeon you activated it in.

* Limit one use per compass. Offer not valid in all Dungeons. Cannot be used in any town.
  Do not attempt to use on pets. Do not eat. Do not taunt the Waypoint Compass.


The semi-permanent Waypoint created is accessible via any Obelisk. The compass waypoint will continue to exist even if a player has travelled through other Zone Portals. Only one compass can be active at a time. Activating another one will overwrite the last one you used. If you log off and log in again, Compasses only remember the level you were on, not the exact layout or monsters killed.

The Waypoint Compass can come in very handy when you wish to Farm a particular Boss zone. When combined with "reset instance" you can quickly redo boss areas for lots of cash and equipment, assuming you can dispatch the boss and its minions quickly.
